name: agent-aura-zcode
description: Sync ZCode hook lifecycle events to the AgentAura ESP32 Ring Light and PetDesktop.

enabled.title: Enable ring sync
enabled.description: Send ZCode lifecycle state changes to the AgentAura ring light.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Device transport: http, udp, or serial.

host.title: Device host
host.description: Ring light IP address for HTTP or UDP. Leave empty to use UDP discovery.

port.title: Device port
port.description: HTTP defaults to 80. UDP defaults to 8888.

serial_port.title: Serial port
serial_port.description: USB CDC serial device path, for example /dev/ttyACM0.

debounce_ms.title: Debounce milliseconds
debounce_ms.description: Minimum interval before the same state is sent again.

cooldown_ms.title: Failure cooldown milliseconds
cooldown_ms.description: How long to pause sending after a device or discovery failure.

timeout_ms.title: Device timeout milliseconds
timeout_ms.description: Timeout for a single device request.

auto_discover.title: Auto discover
auto_discover.description: Discover the ring light on UDP port 8888 when no host is configured.

auth_token.title: Auth token
auth_token.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization header for HTTP requests. Leave empty to skip authentication.
